judgments.rationale: Clause (ii) of the first section applies strictly to electronic requests under clause (i), requiring the applicant's name and reference number. It does not qualify or impose any condition on applicants inspecting public records during opening hours under clause (i) of the second section.

The source requires the agency to publish annual statistics on submitted requests; it does not condition an applicant's ability to submit an electronic request on the agency having already published those statistics.
The duty to publish annual statistics falls on the agency under clause (iii), not on the applicants submitting requests.

The requirement that an electronic request include the applicant's name and reference number is a distinct statutory duty set forth in clause (ii) and is already captured by claim C0001. Appending it into C0000 duplicates C0001 without addressing any defect in the permission defined in clause (i).
